Fixed in PR #14 (merged 3b3a4f5). zx5: unreadable sources are retained and reported instead of deleted, with a disk-existence check so genuinely deleted files still go. 5qy: the scheme verdict keys off scheme-critical columns only, and a failed migration records which columns it left. 6y7: the second pdfminer pass is skipped when OCR is absent. z9u: measured in throwaway venvs — imdecodemulti first exists in 4.7.0.68, and no wheel before 4.10.0.84 imports under numpy 2, so the floor is now >=4.10.0.84 with all four components.
